title: Brainstorm: YuE2 song model (Flow, audio workspace, DAW widgets)
description: Brainstorm card, no plan yet: how to bring YuE2 (open-source song model with an editable score) into the app. Ideas to explore: a Flow, a first audio workspace, DAW widgets such as a piano roll and a track selector. Links, model facts and the licence decision are in brief.md.
